$comment: Balance targets (TASKS.md V5) compared by tools/balance.mjs, and the playthrough budget (tools/playthrough.mjs). Tools only: the game never reads this file. Every target is provisional: starting values from TASKS.md, to be corrected against hand play in step 5.7.

budget.$comment: a playthrough counts as completed when the ending fires within this many simulated minutes over all attempts and with at most this many deaths

targets.note: careful bot completes 80% or more (provisional, TASKS.md V5)

no region causes more than 40% of all deaths (provisional)
step 5.7: completion saturates with 6 retries, so also: a careful bot finishes with no death in half its runs or more (provisional)
step 5.7: a careful bot that completes died at most once on average (provisional)
step 5.7: an average bot finishes with no death in 15 to 35% of its runs: it completes, but pays for it (provisional)
